definitions.explanation: The year after a referenced event or point in time; not necessarily the calendar year following the current one.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧{翌年|よくとし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{結婚|けっこん}→結婚：02514_kekkon⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: They got married the year after that.

examples.japanese: {翌年|よくとし}、⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{辞|や}めた→辞める：00909_yameru⟧。
examples.english: The following year, I quit the company.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{入学|にゅうがく}→入学：02092_nyuugaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{翌年|よくとし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{留学|りゅうがく}→留学：03677_ryuugaku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: She studied abroad the year after entering school.

examples.japanese: {翌年|よくとし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}つけた→見つける：01180_mitsukeru⟧。
examples.english: In the spring of the following year, I found a new job.

examples.japanese: ⟦{東京|とうきょう}→東京：09564_toukyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}した→引っ越す：01171_hikkosu⟧{翌年|よくとし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{子|こ}ども→子ども：00554_kodomo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生|う}まれた→生まれる：00905_umareru⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦もっと→もっと：00798_motto⟧⟦{広|ひろ}い→広い：00704_hiroi⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}す→探す：00493_sagasu⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Our child was born the year after we moved to Tokyo, so we decided to look for a bigger house.

notes:
{翌年|よくとし} means "the following year" relative to a referenced event or point in time, not relative to today.

COMPOUNDS:
⟦{翌|よく}→翌：03970_yoku⟧ (next, following) + ⟦{年|とし}→年：00486_toshi⟧ (year). Also read as {翌年|よくねん}.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {翌年|よくとし}/{翌年|よくねん}: the year after a past event (narrative)
- ⟦{来年|らいねん}→来年：00745_rainen⟧: next year (from the present moment)

For example, if discussing events in 2020, {翌年|よくとし} refers to 2021, regardless of when you are speaking.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧{翌年|よくとし}: the year after that
- 〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{翌年|よくとし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: in the year following ~
- {翌年|よくとし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧: the following spring

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{前年|ぜんねん}→前年：23906_zennen⟧: the previous year
- ⟦{翌日|よくじつ}→翌日：17960_yokujitsu⟧: the following day
- ⟦{翌月|よくげつ}→翌月：21206_yokugetsu⟧: the following month
